company.name: Doppler
company.shortDescription: Doppler’s developer-first security platform empowers teams to seamlessly manage, orchestrate, & govern secrets at scale.
company.description:
Doppler is the secrets management platform built for security and DevOps. It eliminates hardcoded secrets, secrets sprawl, and unauthorized access by centralizing storage, automating secret rotation, and providing real-time monitoring. Security teams gain audit logs, anomaly detection, and compliance controls to meet ISO 27001 and SOC 2 standards, while DevOps benefits from automated syncs across CI/CD, cloud, and infrastructure. With granular access controls and instant secret updates, teams prevent downtime, reduce risk, and move faster. Whether securing data, cloud workloads, or internal applications, Doppler ensures secrets stay protected, available, and compliant so you can ship with confidence.

It was founded in 2018 and is based in San Francisco, California.
